items.notes: This release also folds in the corrections from 0.1.6: I'd been hardcoding a per-GPU TDP table so the power clamp knew, say, "an A4000 is 200 W" - the kind of assumption a general benchmarking tool shouldn't make - so I removed it. | A sub-10 ms answer window (say, a 2-token answer delivered in one batch) used to divide by a clamped 1 ms sliver and mint a fake ~2000 t/s - the old "C2 avg 799 t/s on a 27B model." Now an unmeasurable window reads n/a and is excluded from the averages, instead of a fabricated number.
